description.value:
Cost 3 Vitae

Duration 1 minute

They are wet when they come out. They dry in the air, mostly.

You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed. When the duration ends the wings come off over the following minute, and you are clumsy 1 until you next rest unless you have landed first.

cinderfall.incomplete: Grants a fly Speed for the duration. This is an activated, duration-limited self-buff shaped exactly like this corpus's own 13 companion-effect pairs (apex-draught -> apex-draught-effect, etc.) and the real pf2e precedent for that shape (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/equipment/juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json + equipment-effects/effect-juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json; feats/class/monk/level-1/gorilla-stance.json + feat-effects/stance-gorilla-stance.json) -- in both, the triggering card's rules: [] is correct and the numeric payload lives on a separate companion Effect item the triggering card GrantItems into. No matching *-effect.json companion exists for this card, so the mechanism is real but the sibling file it would need is missing -- a card-authoring gap, not an engine limitation.
